title: preview preflight job result

state.description: The worst state of the checks.

check.description: The check: reachability, robots, sitemaps, pages, egress, cms or render (new names may be added). A render entry is information (pass, or warn for render.suggested while the settings fetch with http): render.suggested or render.compared with the counts, render.not_configured (once, no counts), render.busy, render.timeout or render.unavailable.

code.description: <area>.<code>, e.g. http.404, robots.disallow, egress.blocked; the admin shows its Swedish text and remediation.

target.description: The URL or host the entry is about.

facts.description: Small facts for the text (counts, status codes; a render entry's rawWords and renderedWords: the main-text words of the page as fetched and as rendered); never page content.

estimatedPages.description: Crawl: in-scope sitemap URLs, compared with maxPages.

cms.description: The CMS preset recognised on the start host (e.g. sitevision).

description: Result of a preview job of kind preflight (connectors design §2.2, §8.1; admin design §4.7, §5.4 step 4): the worst state and one entry per check. A fail blocks the save, a warn explains. Up to 3 HTML start URLs or listed URLs are also rendered: a render entry per page with the raw and rendered main-text word counts.
